adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review replaced the framework-test placeholder with source-supported HCV antiviral activity/toxicity rows, a conflict-preserving database audit for DBAASP/DRAMP/CAMP-linked annotations, and source-bounded final mechanism adjudication. The paper is accepted_with_cautions because exact database IC50/cell-death values and broad database labels remain cautions rather than primary-source exact table values.

materials_exhausted.note: XML/PDF text, OA package figures, linked database rows, merged sequence/experiment rows, and the local supplementary .bin assets were reopened. The .bin supplementary assets are HTML landing duplicates and no spreadsheet/table values were recoverable; this does not block because primary XML/PDF/figures contain the source-supported activity and mechanism evidence.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Table 1 verifies the four peptide sequences and positions. Literature links are source_verified; exact DBAASP/CAMP IC50 and 50% cell-death annotations, DRAMP broad labels, DRAMP29990 sequence-length mismatch, and CAMP Gram+/anticancer labels are preserved as source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 extracted source-supported rows for IC50 range, MTT no-viability-loss statement, broad genotype inhibition percentages, no replicon inhibition, and cell-to-cell transmission reduction with locators and units where the primary source provides them.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Final mechanism is bounded to post-attachment entry inhibition, cell-to-cell transmission reduction, E2-42/E1-E2 pulldown association, and negative replication/receptor-binding boundaries; automated membrane/nucleic-acid placeholders were removed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: No blocking/major issue remains after preserving unsupported database exact values as cautions and closing rwk-complete-test-0001 with strict gate evidence.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP/CAMP exact IC50 values are retained as database annotations; source text supports the four peptides with an IC50 range of 1-5 nM and Figure 1C dose-response context.
Database 50% cell-death thresholds above 0.1 uM are not text/table-labeled locally; source text supports no Huh7.5/CD81 viability effect at 10 nM.
DRAMP29990 sequence string matches E2-42 but lists Sequence_Length 18; primary Table 1 gives a 15-aa peptide.
Local supplementary .bin files are HTML article landing pages with no structured supplement table; no values were fabricated from them.
Database late-life-cycle mechanism wording is preserved as a caution; final mechanism claims are limited to source-located direct assays.
